header_chain.scope: Saved header-chain evidence; skipped payload bytes are not independently verified by this review.

tests.note: Several tests deliberately reproduce unsafe acceptance; a green regression here is evidence of the finding, not tool readiness. Docker and Popen calls are mocked.

findings.finding: Initial unused-name listing does not establish exclusive volume ownership. docker volume create is idempotent; no owner/token reinspection occurs before mount/extraction. A concurrently created existing volume is accepted and written.
findings.required_change: Claim transaction-scoped volume names and verify returned volume identity/unique ownership token immediately before every extraction; serialize cooperating executions with an owned lock. Reject an existing foreign volume regardless of a stale initial listing. Never delete partial/foreign volumes automatically.

findings.finding: Exclusive report creation occurs only in finalization after volumes have been changed. A competing output writer causes extraction to run and then raises FileExistsError, losing the operation report.
findings.required_change: Reserve the report path exclusively before any mutation, retaining a durable in-progress record and updating the same reserved artifact through completion/failure. Keep existing report bytes untouched.

findings.finding: Archive is rehashed during preflight but reopened later. Offline replacement after verification sends changed bytes while the report still claims the old archive hash.
findings.required_change: Bind extraction to the verified file identity and hash the actual streamed bytes, rejecting changes and recording partial volumes. A post-stream mismatch must never become extracted_not_launched; exclude concurrent mutations through a cooperative lock or immutable input snapshot.

findings.finding: No duplicate volume or strip-components validation. A duplicate plan fails only after creating/extracting the first volume; a strip count that removes all paths is not rejected. Current v2 plan has unique names and correct strip counts.
findings.required_change: Validate unique names, safe source basenames and prefix/strip relationships before mutation, plus expected extracted file count/path coverage.

nonblocking_observations: All inspected unsafe absolute/traversal paths, symlinks, hardlinks and devices are rejected before extraction.
An existing or dangling output path is rejected before commands at the initial check.
Virtual TAR end blocks preserve the inspected member list; source bytes need not change.
No deletion or reset of previous volumes appears in the reviewed tool. Failed partial volumes are preserved.
Current source filenames and prefixes are safe; issue04 is a generic preflight gap rather than a malformed current plan.
The preflight df and extraction docker runs should explicitly use --pull never, consistent with the cached-image guarantee.
